declaration.preface: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics  is committed to upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights in all aspects of its operations. We recognize that a strong labor and human rights framework is essential for fostering a positive and inclusive work environment, ensuring fair treatment of employees, and promoting ethical business practices across our supply chain. We believe that respect for human rights is a fundamental responsibility and a key component of sustainable business growth. By embedding ethical labor practices within our corporate culture, we not only protect the rights of our employees but also contribute to the broader global movement for social justice and human dignity.
declaration.declaration: We establish our goals on an annual basis, ensuring that we not only develop the essential capabilities required but also allocate the appropriate resources necessary to effectively implement this policy. Our approach is around fostering innovation and enhancing operational efficiency, all while aligning the supply chain of Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics with the overarching objectives of this policy. Furthermore, our commitment transcends mere adherence to labor laws; we are dedicated to cultivating a workplace environment where diversity is not only recognized but celebrated. We actively work to eliminate any form of discrimination, empowering our employees to unlock their full potential and thrive in a supportive and inclusive atmosphere.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

focusAreas: Prohibition of Forced and Child Labor
Child labor, forced labor, and human trafficking

Compliance with International Standards: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics adheres to the principles outlined in the United Nations Universal Declaration of Human Rights, the International Labour Organization (ILO) Conventions, and other relevant international frameworks, including the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. We also align our practices with the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC) and other sustainability charters where applicable.
Non-Discrimination: We prohibit discrimination in hiring, promotion, compensation, or any other employment-related decisions based on race, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, nationality, or any other protected characteristic.
Equal Opportunity: We provide equal opportunities for all employees and ensure a diverse and inclusive work environment.
Fair Compensation: Employees are paid at least the legal minimum wage and provided with benefits in accordance with local labor laws and industry standards.
Workplace Safety: We are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work environment, ensuring compliance with occupational health and safety regulations, and conducting periodic risk assessments.
Anti-Human Trafficking: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics has zero tolerance for human trafficking in any form. We prohibit any involvement in the recruitment, transportation, transfer, harbouring, or receipt of persons through force, fraud, or coercion.
Prohibition of Forced and Child Labor: Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics  strictly prohibits the use of forced, bonded, or involuntary labor in any form and do not engage in or tolerate child labor, ensuring compliance with the minimum employment age as defined by ILO standards and national laws.
Freedom of Association: We respect employees’ rights to freely associate, form labor unions, and engage in collective bargaining. Employees have the right to voice their concerns and negotiate working conditions without fear of retaliation.
Anti-Harassment and Workplace Dignity: We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for harassment, abuse, or any form of intimidation in the workplace. Employees have access to grievance mechanisms to report any workplace misconduct confidentially.
Ethical Supply Chain: Ethical Supply Suppliers, contractors, and business partners are expected to adhere we conduct due diligence to assess labor practices within our supply chain and take corrective actions if violations are identified.
Monitoring and Continuous Improvement: We regularly monitor compliance with this policy through audits, employee feedback, and external assessments. Training programs are provided to employees and management to enhance awareness and implementation of labor and human rights principles.
Reporting Violations: Employees and stakeholders are encouraged to report any violations of this policy through established grievance mechanisms.
Whistleblower Protection: We ensure that whistleblowers are protected against retaliation for reporting violations in good faith.
Learning and Development: We encourage continuous improvement by providing periodic training programs related to ethics, compliance, workplace conduct, health and safety, information security, leadership development, and job-specific competencies to enhance employee knowledge, performance, and long-term career progression.
Employees Health and Safety: We uphold a strict policy of zero tolerance regarding the Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR), emphasizing our commitment to maintaining the highest safety standards in the workplace.

policy.monitoring:
The Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO) presents a comprehensive labor and human rights dashboard to senior management and the Board.

The dashboard highlights progress towards annual labor and human rights targets, emerging trends, and areas needing attention.

A dedicated system for employees to report labor rights violations, discrimination, harassment, or unsafe working conditions.

The Compliance Manager investigates all reports and ensures corrective actions are implemented in a timely manner.

External reporting is conducted annually to communicate our labor and human rights performance to stakeholders, including employees, customers, investors, and regulatory bodies.

Reports are prepared in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGPs) and Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines.

We require suppliers to submit annual reports on their labor and human rights compliance, including any corrective actions taken.

Audits and third-party assessments are conducted to verify compliance with our Supplier Code of Conduct.

We actively engage with employees, suppliers, and other stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and foster transparency in our labor and human rights practices.

Regular stakeholder meetings and surveys help assess the effectiveness of our initiatives and inform continuous improvement efforts.

A formal grievance mechanism is in place to ensure employees and external stakeholders can report violations confidentially and without fear of retaliation.

Grievance reports are reviewed by the Compliance Manager and addressed according to established procedures.
policy.reviewMechanism:
An annual performance review is conducted to assess progress towards labor and human rights goals and targets.

Key achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement are identified through a comprehensive evaluation process.

Feedback from performance reviews, internal audits, and stakeholder engagement activities is used to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Adjustments to labor and human rights strategies, policies, and action plans are made as necessary to enhance compliance and address emerging issues.

The Chief Sustainability Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance with labor and human rights standards.
